name: Dataset Quality Standard & Curriculum Compiler
purpose: Educational curriculum compilation, streaming shard management, deterministic splitting, dynamic vocabulary building, and benchmark decontamination.
registration: CurriculumCompiler::compile creates master curriculum; DatasetEngine auto-registers manual/autonomous datasets; CurriculumEngine compiles model-specific tracks; ExpandableDatasetReader registers streaming shards; ShardedSafeTensorsManager indexes SafeTensors shards.
safety_gates: Strict SPDX permissive license verification on every record
Bidirectional 13-gram shingle cross-split leakage checking guarantees zero train/val/test data leakage
Zero tag deletion policy: preserves 100% of curriculum, pedagogical, and provenance metadata in tokenized records
Strict separation of manual and autonomous dataset registries with zero leakage
Zero unnecessary physical dataset folders: logical internal routing only
self_evolution_link: Dynamic vocabulary builder expands tokenizer from dataset character frequencies.
